package metacontrol

import (
 "bytes"
 "context"
 "crypto/sha256"
 "encoding/json"
 "fmt"
 "io"
 "os"
 "os/exec"
 "path/filepath"
 "strings"
 "testing"
 "time"
 "example.org/gmeta/linked"
)

// G_AUX_IMPLEMENTATION

type metaControlResult struct {
 Name string
 Arguments []string
 CoverEnvironment string
 PrepareError string
 VerifyError string
 ActualExit int
 Watchdog bool
 Output string
 Profile string
}

func TestCoverageMetadataIsolation(t *testing.T) {
 if os.Getenv("G_META_CHILD") == "1" {
  t.Log("META_CHILD_EXECUTED")
  if linked.ChildOnly() != 2 { t.Fatal("child branch") }
  t.Log("META_CHILD_BODY_DONE")
  return
 }
 if linked.ParentOnly() != 1 { t.Fatal("parent branch") }
 outputRoot := os.Getenv("G_META_CONTROL_OUTPUT")
 if outputRoot == "" { t.Fatal("control output missing") }
 var results []metaControlResult
 for _, name := range []string{"positive", "missing-aux", "changed-collection", "changed-fragment", "wrong-association", "preseed"} {
  profileDir, err := os.MkdirTemp(outputRoot, name+"-")
  if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
  item := metaControlResult{Name:name, Profile:filepath.Join(profileDir,"child.atomic.out"), ActualExit:-999}
  arguments := os.Args[1:]
  if name == "changed-fragment" {
   parent := ""
   for _, arg := range arguments { if strings.HasPrefix(arg,"-test.gocoverdir=") { parent=strings.TrimPrefix(arg,"-test.gocoverdir=") } }
   _, fragments, err := downloadGReadAuxCollection(parent)
   if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
   copied := filepath.Join(profileDir,"owned-parent-metadata")
   if err := os.Mkdir(copied,0700);err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
   collection := struct{ImportPaths []string;MetaFileFragments []string}{}
   for i,fragment := range fragments {
    data,err := os.ReadFile(fragment.Path);if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    target:=filepath.Join(copied,fmt.Sprintf("fragment%d",i))
    if err := os.WriteFile(target,data,0600);err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
    collection.ImportPaths=append(collection.ImportPaths,fragment.ImportPath)
    collection.MetaFileFragments=append(collection.MetaFileFragments,target)
   }
   data,err := json.Marshal(collection);if err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
   if err := os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(copied,"metafiles.txt"),data,0600);err != nil { t.Fatal(err) }
   arguments=[]string{"-test.gocoverdir="+copied}
  }
  if name == "preseed" {
   dir:=filepath.Join(profileDir,"covdata")
   if err:=os.Mkdir(dir,0700);err != nil {t.Fatal(err)}
   if err:=os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir,"foreign-counters"),[]byte("not accepted coverage"),0600);err != nil {t.Fatal(err)}
  }
  coverDir,err := downloadGPrepareChildCover(arguments,profileDir)
  if err != nil {
   item.PrepareError=err.Error()
   if name != "preseed" || !strings.Contains(err.Error(),"fresh child coverage directory required") {t.Fatal(err)}
   results=append(results,item)
   continue
  }
  if name == "preseed" { t.Fatal("preseeded coverage directory accepted") }
  if name == "missing-aux" {
   if err:=os.Remove(filepath.Join(coverDir,"metafiles.txt"));err != nil {t.Fatal(err)}
  }
  if name == "changed-collection" {
   file:=filepath.Join(coverDir,"metafiles.txt");data,err:=os.ReadFile(file);if err != nil {t.Fatal(err)}
   if err:=os.WriteFile(file,append(data,'\n'),0600);err != nil {t.Fatal(err)}
  }
  if name == "wrong-association" {
   file:=filepath.Join(coverDir,"metafiles.txt");data,err:=os.ReadFile(file);if err != nil {t.Fatal(err)}
   var collection struct{ImportPaths []string;MetaFileFragments []string}
   if err:=json.Unmarshal(data,&collection);err != nil {t.Fatal(err)}
   if len(collection.ImportPaths)<2 {t.Fatal("auxiliary association control needs2packages")}
   collection.ImportPaths[0],collection.ImportPaths[1]=collection.ImportPaths[1],collection.ImportPaths[0]
   data,err=json.Marshal(collection);if err != nil {t.Fatal(err)}
   if err:=os.WriteFile(file,data,0600);err != nil {t.Fatal(err)}
  }
  if name == "changed-fragment" {
   parent:=strings.TrimPrefix(arguments[0],"-test.gocoverdir=")
   _,fragments,err:=downloadGReadAuxCollection(parent);if err != nil {t.Fatal(err)}
   found:=false
   for _,fragment:=range fragments {
    if strings.HasSuffix(fragment.ImportPath,"/auxiliary") {
     if err:=os.WriteFile(fragment.Path,[]byte{0},0600);err != nil {t.Fatal(err)}
     found=true
    }
   }
   if !found {t.Fatal("unlinked auxiliary metadata missing")}
  }
  ctx,cancel:=context.WithTimeout(context.Background(),15*time.Second)
  cmd:=exec.CommandContext(ctx,os.Args[0],"-test.run=^TestCoverageMetadataIsolation$","-test.v","-test.timeout=12s","-test.coverprofile="+item.Profile,"-test.gocoverdir="+coverDir)
  for _,value:=range os.Environ() {if !strings.HasPrefix(value,"GOCOVERDIR=") && !strings.HasPrefix(value,"G_META_CHILD=") {cmd.Env=append(cmd.Env,value)}}
  cmd.Env=append(cmd.Env,"GOCOVERDIR="+coverDir,"G_META_CHILD=1")
  item.Arguments=cmd.Args;item.CoverEnvironment=coverDir
  output,err:=cmd.CombinedOutput();item.Output=string(output);item.Watchdog=ctx.Err()!=nil;cancel()
  if cmd.ProcessState!=nil {item.ActualExit=cmd.ProcessState.ExitCode()}
  if item.Watchdog || !strings.Contains(item.Output,"META_CHILD_EXECUTED") || !strings.Contains(item.Output,"META_CHILD_BODY_DONE") {t.Fatalf("actual child invalid %+v",item)}
  if name == "changed-fragment" {
   if err == nil || item.ActualExit == 0 {t.Fatal("corrupted metadata fragment escaped actual Go decoder")}
  } else if err != nil || item.ActualExit != 0 {t.Fatalf("unexpected actual child failure %+v",item)}
  if err:=downloadGVerifyChildCover(profileDir);err != nil {item.VerifyError=err.Error()}
  if (name=="positive") != (item.VerifyError=="") {t.Fatalf("metadata integrity verdict differs %+v",item)}
  results=append(results,item)
 }
 data,err:=json.MarshalIndent(results,"","  ");if err != nil {t.Fatal(err)}
 if err:=os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(outputRoot,"results.json"),append(data,'\n'),0600);err != nil {t.Fatal(err)}
}
